name: aeo-platform
description: Open-source AEO platform for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity — measure brand visibility, audit AI-bot crawlability + authority signals, diagnose citation gaps, recommend per-engine actions, and export a JSON brand-context you paste into any AI for a personalized 30-mission AEO plan. Free alternative to Profound, Otterly, Peec, Bluefish. Zero dependencies, MIT, local-first.
